name: gkjohnson/three-gpu-pathtracer
description: GPU-accelerated path tracing renderer and utilities for three.js built on three-mesh-bvh, supporting physically-based GGX materials, skinned meshes, area lights, volumes, and depth of field in WebGL 2.
score_rationale: 1.7k-star actively maintained WebGL path tracer for three.js with broad feature coverage and production-quality output.
summary: GPU-accelerated three.js path tracer with PBR materials and advanced WebGL 2 features.
